verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's docs describe a fully independent EU hosted instance in Frankfurt for data residency needs. Its self-hosting docs (Docker Compose and several PaaS options) let users run it anywhere, and community users confirm self-hosting is easy and stable, so users can fully control data location. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the other hosted region options (e.g., the default region) and of any way to move data between hosted regions.
